attackers_goals: Usage of the Kubernetes API server to perform operations inside the cluster.
description: A command was executed from within a Kubernetes pod using Kubelet credentials. This activity allows an attacker to impersonate the node and perform privileged operations against the cluster API.
investigative_actions: Check if there is an active attack against the Kubernetes cluster.
name: Execution of command from within a Kubernetes pod using kubelet credentials
